reader.requirement: While each print line is presented LINE-COUNTER equals the line number it is presented on (visible to a SOURCE LINE-COUNTER on that line), and after a group LINE-COUNTER takes the final setting of the 1985 presentation rules tables (XIII-24ff: RH 5a-5e, PH 4a-4b, body 6a-6f including the lower-level CF whose NEXT GROUP is ignored, PF, RF, and the unpaged rules).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.TerminateDiscardsSavedNextGroup (2002+): at 85 a saved absolute NEXT GROUP integer is kept, so TERMINATE's first control footing meets it (1985 body rule 3b)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: after an absolute NEXT GROUP that went to the save location, TERMINATE's first control footing is placed from the save location at 85 (new page, line saved+1) and on the same page at 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness is an unpaged report; paged RH NEXT GROUP, PH absolute-then-relative, the lower-level CF NEXT GROUP rule and the save location at TERMINATE are not exercised

reader.notes: PresentLine sets LineCounter = target before composing the line, so a SOURCE LINE-COUNTER reads the line's number; final settings come from ApplyNextGroup (applied only at the break level, matching 1985 6a/6b/6f), and the one edition arm, at TERMINATE, follows the 1985 text.
